Phone settings vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume call-filter capability in the binary or a companion guide covers storefront language. Xcode, Phone settings, and Connect actually separate unknown-caller behavior from product-page copy:

  • Silence Unknown Callers (Settings → Phone) — system toggle that sends calls from numbers not in Contacts, Mail, or Messages straight to voicemail without ringing. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Call Directory & IdentityLookup extensions — optional app extensions that label or block known spam numbers. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains unknown-caller silence value to buyers.
  • In-app call-filter UI — setup wizards, blocked-call lists, quiet-inbox dashboards, and toggle explainers. Your listing may mention block unknown numbers; implementing call-directory data is engineering work, not listing copy.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of call-filter flags in the binary.

Working unknown-caller silence in the app or system settings and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.
